title: FlexLine Returned-Payment Fee Booked After the Return Month
content:
| Whole calendar months from the return date to the booking date | Share applied to the FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit returned-payment fee |
|---|---|
| two or more | 0.75 |
| one | 0.90 |
| less than one | 1.00 |

The late-booking share follows the whole calendar months from the return date to the booking date: two months or more give 0.75; one month gives 0.90; less than one month gives 1.00. The share multiplies the fee as figured, before the fee is held to no more than the minimum payment due and rounded to the cent.

Months are counted from the return date to the booking date, a month counting only once the booking date's day of the month reaches the return date's day of the month.

*Hypothetical dates:* a payment returned on 14 January and its fee booked on 13 February — 0 months, share 1.00; booked on 14 February — 1 month, 0.90; booked on 14 March — 2 months, 0.75.
